name: MQTTBoard
description: MQTT client application inspired by Workswithweb MQTTBox.
author: Chavee Issariyapat

scripts.icons: mkdir -p build/icons build/icons.iconset && cp src/www/images/icon-source-modern.png build/icons/icon.png && sips -z 16 16 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_16x16.png && sips -z 32 32 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_16x16@2x.png && sips -z 32 32 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_32x32.png && sips -z 64 64 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_32x32@2x.png && sips -z 128 128 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_128x128.png && sips -z 256 256 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_128x128@2x.png && sips -z 256 256 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_256x256.png && sips -z 512 512 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_256x256@2x.png && sips -z 512 512 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_512x512.png && sips -z 1024 1024 build/icons/icon.png --out build/icons.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png && iconutil -c icns build/icons.iconset -o build/icons/icon.icns && rm -rf build/icons.iconset
